_comment: The production image of this repository and what it is made of (atrium-project#72 A.3).
Checked on every push by the hub's workflow-lint.reusable.yml (tools/ci/image_closure.py):
every first-party file the entrypoint can execute must be listed here or be a hub-canonical
shared component (docs/templates/shared/MANIFEST.json); a listed file it no longer reaches
fails too. Run it locally with: python ../atrium-project/tools/ci/image_closure.py
The pilot pins `-api` (python -m service.api); `base` is the batch CLI of the same stage
(keywords.py), published, never pinned. The controlled kind (atrium-keyword-extract#1, #2)
is in the closure since 2026-10-07: llm_client_shared.py and the two backend clients
(openrouter_client.py, ollama_client.py) call an inference service, prompt_template.py
renders prompts/system_prompt.txt, and vocab_manager.py reads the built vocabulary and
resolves entities[].pid; the image carries no model weights. The research GPU path
(llm_run.py, llm_utils.py) and the vocabulary build and review tools (vocab_build.py,
vocab_sources.py, vocab_review.py, corpus_review.py) stay out of it. api_util/teitok_read.py
and bbox_scale.py are nlp-enrich's, pinned by tests/test_vendored_teitok_parity.py.
stage: keywords of the record or a text: statistical (per document and page, with method and score) and controlled (the AMČR/TEATER vocabulary term of each line, by an LLM through an inference service): POST /extract_keywords, /extract_keywords_text
